note: The tech channel's formats, tiers from research/families.json and the labels (18 Nov 2026). examples: the niche hits each rests on.

formats.name: How a thing you use was invented
formats.emotion: the delight of a familiar thing's odd origin
formats.hook: The thing on screen, already moving, and the question in the first line: 'Your keyboard isn't in ABC order. Why?'
formats.beats: the everyday thing and the question -> the first version, built in 3D in front of you -> the problem it had -> the fix that shaped what you hold today -> the payoff: the surprising reason -> loop to the thing in your hand

examples.title: How Mr. Potato Head Was Invented 🤔
How You Accidentally Invented the Mechanical Typewriter⌨️
Most Important Invention In History, Part 2: The Radio

formats._why: tech-history Shorts: modern inventions 142 videos, median 22K, 25% hits (families.json, labels)

formats.name: Zoom inside: one dive through scales or one part taken apart
formats.emotion: awe at how small and precise it is
formats.hook: Frame 0 is the familiar object already moving; by 1.5 s the camera dives into it. First line names it and the scale: 'Inside this chip are 92 billion switches.'
formats.beats: the object -> the dive (each scale a beat, a scale badge and a familiar comparison) -> the smallest part doing its job -> the payoff figure felt at body scale -> pull back out to the first frame (loop)

formats.name: How a machine works (power, vehicles, rockets, drones)
formats.emotion: finally seeing the inside of something huge
formats.hook: A cutaway of the machine running at frame 0, the question in the first line: 'How does a dam turn falling water into your lights?'
formats.beats: the machine running -> cutaway: the flow through it on glowing paths -> the key part, exploded -> the number that makes it work, felt -> payoff -> loop

formats.name: How an everyday gadget works
formats.emotion: the thing on my desk is cleverer than I thought
formats.hook: The gadget doing its job at frame 0, the question in the first line
formats.beats: the gadget in use -> cutaway -> the one trick inside -> payoff -> loop

formats.name: AI skit: a 3D character acts out how an AI or gadget behaves
formats.emotion: laughing at the machine, then understanding it
formats.hook: The character mid-problem at frame 0, a 2-3 word label on top
formats.beats: the gag set up in one wide shot -> the AI made physical (a scan dome, a glowing answer) -> the twist -> the real explanation in one line -> loop

formats.name: What happens inside X when you Y

formats.hook: The viewer's own action (tap, ask, unlock) plus one huge comparison within 10 s; a map of the video by 60 s
